prompt_rules.text: Before a bulk, destructive, or irreversible action, resolve the exact target set from authoritative reads. If the request combines conditions, fetch each condition separately and compute the intersection; do not broaden an item to its containing collection. If it references a source collection or lifecycle object, inspect the source-specific API, reconcile current mutable state, and choose the operation that moves, updates, or consumes the exact object. Before checkout, show the cart, remove or clear unrelated pre-existing items, add only requested products and quantities, re-read the cart, and verify payment and delivery constraints. For a scheduled or future communication, inspect the relevant creation API for a scheduling field and do not substitute an immediate generic send. After the side effect, verify the final source and target state. For read-only work or an already-unambiguous target, proceed without unnecessary discovery.

examples: When a request combines conditions, fetch each authoritative set and compute the exact intersection; do not broaden one set to its container.

Before checkout, show the cart; clear or remove unrelated pre-existing items, add only requested products and quantities, re-read the cart, and use a source-specific move API when buying from a wishlist.
For an existing email, thread, or draft, inspect relation-specific reply, forward, or send-from-draft APIs; choose the one that updates or consumes the exact source object, then verify the result.
For a scheduled or future message, inspect the creation API for a scheduling field; use that lifecycle rather than an immediate generic send, then verify the resulting scheduled objects.
